title: Add Codeverter to build
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Codeverter](https://fadyabohamza-netizen.github.io/codeverter) to build
- Convert code between 9+ programming languages with AI. BYOP Pollinations-powered.

Fixes #14988

gist.headline: Nine tongues, one hive
gist.blurb: Codeverter has joined the garden: bring your own Pollinations key and let AI help code travel between nine-plus programming languages. The syntax migratory season is now open.
gist.summary: Added the Pollinations-powered Codeverter app to the build, giving users a BYOP tool for converting code between more than nine programming languages with AI.
gist.impact: Users can discover and run Codeverter from the app build to translate code across 9+ languages using their own Pollinations-powered setup.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Codeverter as a cozy multilingual code garden: labeled code scrolls or terminal panes in several language-like colors flow through a friendly converter machine and emerge as new scrolls. Polli, wearing tiny translator glasses and carrying a clipboard, oversees the translation while code-plants and flowers grow around the retro workstation.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art garden workshop where the cute pixel bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a small happy smile, and small rounded light-blue translucent wings wears tiny translator glasses and guides colorful code scrolls through a chunky retro “CODEVERTER” machine, emerging as scrolls in many programming languages amid sprouting code-plants and flowers. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful.
